description: Figure 4 illustrates the proportion of incorrectly and correctly answered samples relating to three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled “Movies”, “Songs”, and “Basketball” in that order, while the vertical axis represents the proportion, labeled “Pop(%)”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at 20-unit intervals. Three bars are presented for each category, representing “Pop_GT”, “Pop_Ge”, and “Pop_GT (also Pop_Ge)”. For the “Movies” category, “Pop_GT” is represented by a blue bar reaching approximately 70%, “Pop_Ge” is represented by an orange bar reaching approximately 60%, and “Pop_GT (also Pop_Ge)” is represented by a gray bar reaching approximately 65%. For “Songs”, “Pop_GT” is a blue bar reaching approximately 80%, “Pop_Ge” is an orange bar reaching approximately 70%, and “Pop_GT (also Pop_Ge)” is a gray bar reaching approximately 75%. Finally, for “Basketball”, “Pop_GT” is a blue bar reaching approximately 55%, “Pop_Ge” is an orange bar reaching approximately 45%, and “Pop_GT (also Pop_Ge)” is a gray bar reaching approximately 50%. The bars are grouped by category, with each group containing one blue, one orange, and one gray bar. The bars are arranged alphabetically by category name.
